# Hunger
Everyone gets hungry sometimes.
Hunger has four states: [color=green]okay[/color], [color=lightskyblue]peckish[/color], [color=orange]hungry[/color], and [color=red]starving[/color]. While you're hungry or starving, your movement speed is slowed significantly.
Each bite of a piece of food [bold]immediately reduces your hunger by 1 stage[/bold]. Most foods only have 1 portion, but most cooked foods have up to 3, 4, or even 5.
Some foods have reagents in them, which may be helpful or harmful. Each portion of food will have the same amount of reagents in it.
Your hunger decays over time. After eating a meal, the timer for your hunger decay is reset. While you're full (at "okay" hunger), you cannot eat anymore.
Some say that, in the future, you may be able to "Expend" your "Hunger" to perform various "Actions". That's strange??!?!
